backend.rootCodeRule: Backend business code must live under backend/modules/<feature>/{api,service,domain,repository}/. Root-level backend code is allowed only for explicitly registered non-business bootstrap placeholders.
backend.commonRule: backend/common may contain cross-module utilities only; it must not own feature behavior.

requirements: Every reviewed legacy boundary finding must name one exact normalized repository file, one or more exact target feature ids, a canonical SHA256, a non-empty reason, and a full source commit.
A legacy boundary baseline consumes only the named file-target finding while the exact file hash matches; any additional target remains a violation.
Glob paths, directory paths, duplicate findings, missing files, hash drift, and stale expected targets must fail the gate.
The exception file must use structured entries with an exact backticked repository file, one target feature id, and a non-empty reason.
The named file must be an actual file in the current changed-files.json; historical or untouched files cannot borrow the current change exception.
allow-all, prose-only path mentions, unstructured path bullets, glob paths, directory paths, duplicate entries, stale findings, and whole-file skips are forbidden.
